Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: opening scene illustration for The Whispering Sands, a cooperative RPG for two people.
Primary request: Illustrate the opening location after a violent storm has wrecked a small boat on an uncharted tropical island. View from the beach: wet dark sand, scattered wooden boat fragments and ropes in the foreground, surf and towering cliffs, dense palms and ancient carvings partly visible on a weathered tree at the forest edge. Dawn is breaking after the storm; warm sunlight threads through moody clouds and sea mist.
Style/medium: beautiful cinematic painterly adventure concept art, detailed atmospheric environment, grounded survival mystery, subtle brush texture, rich deep teal shadows and warm sand and copper highlights.
Composition/framing: wide landscape composition, strong depth, no interface elements, environment only with no people; the players will appear in the game interface separately.
Constraints: no talisman, no ghosts, no future story spoilers, no lettering, no logos, no watermarks.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: canonical scene style reference and opening shore illustration for The Whispering Sands, an intimate cooperative archaeological island mystery.
Input image 1: geographical reference. Keep the storm-wrecked small boat debris on a tropical shore, wet sand, grey ocean, rocky forested cliffs, one weathered tree with indistinct carvings. Do not copy glossy epic cinematography. No people or spoilers.
Primary request: Reinterpret this shore as a beautiful plate from an old expedition field journal. View at human eye level from the beach after the storm. A few broken planks and tangled rope close by, water receding quietly between rocks, distant cliffs lost in a wide bank of pale sea mist, foliage as irregular brush masses, soft overcast morning. Intimate and credible rather than grand fantasy.
Style/medium: distinctly hand-painted opaque gouache with sparse pencil and scratched ink details on warm ivory paper; unpainted pale mist and paper at outer edges; dry brush, visible pigment, simplified masses, reserved fine detail for boat wood and shoreline; reminiscent of an observant naturalist's field sketch. Not a photo, not 3D, not slick digital concept art.
Palette: restrained sea-grey, dusty eucalyptus and olive, raw umber, pale ochre, grey-white sky. Warm paper light. Matte pigment, low saturation.
Composition: wide landscape, calm asymmetrical composition, foreground evidence left, empty pale sky upper third, not symmetrical, no giant sunbeams, no central glowing object. No text, lettering, numbers, logos, borders, interface, talisman, supernatural effects or people.
